listing.name: inFAMOUS 2 — infamous2-recomp (erikomis)
listing.summary: Upstream reports startup, menus, cutscenes and the first New Marais missions. This alpha has never been tested from start to finish. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own digital NPUA80638 package, license and game files. This guide does not specify the required update; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the v0.2.12 alpha app to rebuild locally from your own copy. Upstream has offered self-update since version 0.2.7.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, menus, cutscenes and the first New Marais missions. This alpha has never been tested from start to finish.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
